section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)

content.description: Exploded view showing spring cage, one-way clutch, and thrust washer assembly

content.text: 4. INSTALL THRUST WASHER AND ONE-WAY CLUTCH

items: (a) Install the thrust washer, facing the grooves upward.
(b) Install the one-way clutch in correct direction.

content.text: NOTE: Be sure that the spring cage side of the one-way clutch faces toward the front of the transmission.

content.description: Cross-section view showing clutch piston installation in overdrive clutch drum

content.text: 5. INSTALL CLUTCH PISTON IN OVERDRIVE CLUTCH DRUM

items: (a) Install new O-rings on the piston. Coat the O-rings with ATF.
(b) Press the piston into the drum with the cup side up, being careful not to damage the O-ring.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of eighteen piston return springs with SST tool and snap ring placement

content.text: 6. INSTALL EIGHTEEN PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND SET RETAINER AND SNAP RING IN PLACE
7. COMPRESS RETURN SPRINGS AND INSTALL SNAP RING IN GROOVE

items: (a) Place SST on the spring retainer, and compress the springs on a shop press.
(b) Install the snap ring with a screwdriver.

content.description: Exploded view showing assembly order of flange, disc, plate, and cushion plate components

content.text: 8. INSTALL CUSHION PLATE, PLATE, DISC AND FLANGE WITHOUT ASSEMBLING THINNER SNAP RING

items: (a) Do not assemble the thinner snap ring yet.
(b) Using low-pressure compressed air, blow all excess ATF from the disc.

content.text: CAUTION: High-pressure air will damage the disc.
Install in order: Cushion plate-plate-disc-flange (flat end down)

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of piston stroke using dial indicator with clutch hub installed

content.text: 9. CHECK PISTON STROKE OF OVERDRIVE CLUTCH

items: (a) Install the overdrive clutch hub and outer snap ring.
(b) Install the front clutch into the oil pan assembly. With a dial indicator, measure the stroke applying and releasing the compressed air (14 — 8 kg/cm², 57 — 114 psi or 392 — 785 kPa) as shown.

content.text: If the stroke exceeds limit, the clutch pack is probably worn. If the stroke is less than the limit, parts may be misassembled or there may be excess ATF on the discs.
